Since \(x\) divides both \(19250-11=19239\) and \(20302-3=20299\), it must divide their difference:

\[
20299-19239=1060
\]

Now compute the gcd:

\[
\gcd(19239,20299)=53
\]

Since the divisor must be greater than the remainders \(11\) and \(3\), the only possible divisor is \(53\).

\[
\boxed{53}
\]
